notes:
Lead profile: small edtech startup building a conversational tutor (student Q&A, doc summarization). Signed up via self-serve, primary interest is hosted_api (fast onboarding).

Conversation highlights / customer quotes:
- 'We need to be sure student prompts aren't retained beyond a short window.'
- 'Can parents opt out of data collection for under-16 accounts?'
- 'Will prompts or embeddings be used to improve models or appear in other customers' contexts?'

Primary privacy & retention concerns (shorthand):
- log retention window: wants configurable retention (30 days default, option for 0/7/30/90), wants explicit SLA on purge timing after request
- opt-out: must support account-level opt-out + per-user opt-out for analytics/training; legal team requests documentation on what opt-out covers
- prompt storage: ask whether prompts are persisted, for how long, and whether they are accessible to humans (redaction, access controls)
- embeddings: worried about persistent embeddings that could be reidentified; asked if we can avoid storing embeddings or apply one-way hashing
- telemetry: needs audit logs for admin actions, access to token-level usage logs for troubleshooting (but with redaction of PII)

Technical constraints / perf:
- workload: mostly chat with occasional batch summarization jobs; low concurrency (tens of users), bursty during evening tutoring windows
- latency target: 150-250ms p95 token latency desired for interactive tutor flows, though they understand hosted API may vary
- cost sensitivity: high — wants guidance on batching & cache settings to keep costs < $1k/mo after free credits

Requests made to Redwood during call:
- security FAQ + SOC2 report copy (requested drive link above)
